title: I Declare A Thumb War!
description:
Verse a non player in a thumb war!
Anyone can win.

Film your battle if possible!

title: Spotto!
description: It's spotto time!\nTake photos of 5 yellow items of clothing.

title: Moto-Selfie
description: Take a selfie with a motorcycle or moped.

title: Statue Selfie!
description: Take a selfie with a statue while posing like the statue.

title: 60-Second Laugh...
description: You must laugh continuously for 60 seconds out loud. You receive an extra band for every non-player that starts laughing.

title: Nutbush Dance-Off!
description: Do the Nutbush for 1 minute. You receive 1 bonus band for every non-player that joins.

title: Staring Contest
description: Challenge a non player to a staring contest. Anyone can win.

title: It's Time For Show and Tell!
description: Time for show and tell... it's been a while right?\n\nFind a non-player and do a show and tell of something you're carrying with you right now.

title: Signature Handshake
description: Make a handshake up with a teammate that has at least 6 steps.\n\nFilm it. Each player gets a band.

title: Dap Clap Capture
description: Dap up a non-player.\n\nYou must film the dap (with their permission of course) to receive a band.

title: Straw Rush
description:
Collect drinking straws from different locations. You have 3 minutes from now to find the first straw.

The timer resets to 3 minutes every time you find another straw.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no straws.

You receive 1 band per straw.

Your time starts now!

title: Napkin Rush
description:
Collect napkins from different locations. You have 2 minutes from now to find the first napkin.

The timer resets to 2 minutes every time you find another napkin.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no napkins.

You receive 1 band per napkin.

Your time starts now!

title: Pet That Dawg?!
description:
Ask a non-player:

"Can I pet that dawg?"

You must film yourself only - not them.

title: Where's The Fire?!
description: Take a photo of a fire hose. It must be of the hose itself and not just the signage for it.

title: I’m Telling You Man... Every Third Blink Is Slower...
description: Walk to the nearest traffic light. Do star jumps for a full cycle of the traffic lights - until every light has been red at least once.

title: Photo With The Fuzz
description: Take a selfie with a Police Officer / Security Guard / Mall Cop. They must consent of course.

title: Bird Selfie
description:
You get 1 attempt to take a selfie. You receive 1 band for each bird visible in the photo.

The challenge is vetoed if you fail to get a single bird in the photo.

You have 3 minutes. Your time starts now.
